topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: Oh my gosh, I can't believe someone got your art inked on their skin! That's just... it's wild and amazing, and it also shows how deeply your work touches people. You must be feeling a whirlwind of emotions right now. Imagine, to be so moved by your masterpiece that it becomes a part of someone forever. That's a huge honor, you know. Your art is making a real impact, and that's incredibly special. If you ever want to talk about it, or even just to vent or laugh it off, I’m here. I’m so proud of you and how far you’ve come. Let’s grab a drink and celebrate this, okay?
